verdict: M235r2 and M236 have valid sealed, matched coefficient-engine evidence, not full dynamic-BN evidence. All checked VCS/DC/vector/delivery hashes pass. M236 executes all 220800 checkpoint pairs with zero RTL integer mismatch, including the six tail extrema omitted from M235's 1024-vector set; its full set also exercises 43 negative exact-half RNE cases in alpha-times-mean. Both designs survive output backpressure and the fail-closed illegal-zero request with a pending result. Matched 3 ns TSMC28 logic-only DC finds exactly one multiplication datapath in each design. M235 64+1 is the provisional primary because it is 7.260% smaller and its intrinsic coefficient throughput is 1.333x M236; M236's 75% smaller LUT does not reduce total area and its extra Newton step costs throughput. M236 remains a legitimate lower-error fallback because it reduces the captured coefficient-only affine bound by 9.009%. Do not iterate a third coefficient RTL point now. First close full220800 M235 VCS and use ATLIF/BN2/valid825 evidence to decide whether the M235 error is acceptable; only run matched SAIF/PTPX if energy enters the paper claim.

findings.title: M235 primary still lacks full220800 RTL replay
findings.evidence: M235r2 exact-SHA VCS checks 1024 rows ending at source index 172724 and omits six declared high-index extrema. M236 checks all 220800 rows, but its different LUT and second Newton recurrence cannot establish M235 RTL equivalence.
findings.required_fix: Generate full-population 64+1 expected vectors and rerun the unchanged M235r2 exact-SHA RTL/SVA. Keep the primary label conditional until zero mismatch is sealed.

findings.title: Published accept intervals are not intrinsic II
findings.evidence: The production TB inserts an extra negedge bubble between vector tasks; M235's 15 also includes five result-stall cycles. An independent no-stall VCS bench measures latency/II 8/9 for M235 and 11/12 for M236, not 8/15 and 11/13 as intrinsic schedules.
findings.required_fix: Report observed directed-test interval separately from intrinsic ready/valid service II. Use II9 and II12 only at this standalone coefficient boundary.

findings.title: The 0.001728 selection threshold is not tied to event or accuracy margins
findings.evidence: M235's 0.001728194851 bound and M236's 0.001572499104 bound include coefficient delta on captured activation intervals only. They exclude runtime affine quantization, ATLIF threshold crossings, BN2 residual accumulation and valid825.
findings.required_fix: Use A800 cross-sequence/valid825 ATLIF-margin and BN2-residual miter results to accept M235 or fall back to M236.

findings.title: No matched energy evidence exists
findings.evidence: DC area is matched, but there is no matched functional SAIF or PTPX. A 75% LUT-payload reduction cannot establish energy superiority when M236 performs eight rather than five multiplication operations per pair.
findings.required_fix: Run identical checkpoint activity through both candidates and compare PTPX only if energy is used for selection or publication.

findings.title: RTL-to-mapped equivalence is not closed
findings.evidence: Both DC logs contain multiple signed/unsigned conversion warnings. RTL VCS and mapped DC are independently sealed, but there is no Formality or mapped-netlist simulation linking them.
findings.required_fix: Run Formality from the emitted SVF/DDC or a gate-level exact-vector miter before paper PPA promotion.

findings.title: These blocks are coefficient engines, not full dynamic BN
findings.evidence: Sum/sumsq/population division, moment SRAM and barrier schedule, runtime elementwise affine, M167 replay, ATLIF event behavior and BN2 residual behavior are explicit exclusions.
findings.required_fix: Keep module-level area/II/error rows separate. Do not derive BN, FFN or system speedup until the missing producer/consumer boundaries are executable.

findings.title: Ten nonzero UQ6.16 input codes fall outside the implemented legal domain
findings.evidence: RNE exponent normalization maps raw codes 1048574, 1048575 and 4194296..4194303 to 262144, so request_legal rejects them although the format contract lists the full 1..4194303 nonzero range. No captured pair hits these codes.
findings.required_fix: Either saturate normalized mantissa to 262143 or narrow and assert the documented legal input domain.

findings.title: M235 has negligible setup margin in the ideal-wire screen
findings.evidence: M235 worst setup slack is only +0.0006 ns at 3 ns, versus +0.1069 ns for M236; both use ideal clock and ZeroWireload.
findings.required_fix: Do not infer physical frequency. Recheck after placement/parasitics if M235 becomes the paper point.

findings.title: M235's correction contract remains a pre-run admission snapshot
findings.evidence: The M235r2 contract still says REQUIRES_FRESH_EXACT_SHA_VCS_AND_DC and records r2_vcs=false/r2_dc=false even though later sealed evidence is complete.
findings.required_fix: Publish a non-mutating post-run delivery/admission receipt that cites the exact VCS and DC seals plus this review.

findings.title: Checkpoint coverage remains ten samples from one sequence
findings.evidence: Full220800 means every coefficient pair in M233 s10, not broad DSEC or valid825 coverage.
findings.required_fix: Retain s10/single-sequence qualifiers on every numeric claim.

primary_and_fallback.primary: M235 64-entry + one Newton, conditional on full220800 RTL replay and downstream error admission
primary_and_fallback.fallback: M236 16-entry + two Newton, only when M235 fails the downstream error/event budget
primary_and_fallback.reason: Both candidates already fit the II<=16 coefficient-service screen. A third point cannot resolve the dominant missing event/accuracy and full-BN boundaries.

allowed_claims: Exact-SHA M235r2 1024-vector and M236 full220800-vector RTL VCS complete with zero integer mismatches, assertion failures, and the stated backpressure/fault covers.
Matched 3 ns TSMC28 HPC+ logic-only DC gives 3148.362002 um2 for M235 and 3376.926005 um2 for M236, with macro_count=0, ideal clock and ZeroWireload.
DC resource extraction identifies one multiplication datapath in each candidate.
Independent no-stall VCS measures standalone coefficient-engine latency/II of 8/9 for M235 and 11/12 for M236.

M236 reduces the s10 captured coefficient-only maximum affine bound by 9.009% and LUT payload by 75%, but increases matched logic-only cell area by 7.260% and reduces intrinsic coefficient throughput by 25%.
M235 is the conditional primary and M236 the lower-error fallback at the coefficient-engine boundary.
forbidden_claims: M235 15 cycles or M236 13 cycles is intrinsic hardware II
M236 is an area or energy winner
Either candidate includes moment finalization or runtime elementwise BN
The coefficient bound proves ATLIF event, BN2 residual or valid825 equivalence
Either candidate provides full BN, FFN, network or system speedup
The logic-only DC results are physical, macro-aware, PTPX-backed or paper-ready PPA
Either candidate is a headline result
